Quinn O'Brien  
Senior QA Engineer - Cybersecurity Test Lead | SecureSphere Cybersecurity Solutions  
Email: quinn.o'brien@securesphere.com | Phone: +31 6 1234 5678 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/quinoberlin | Address: Amsterdam, Netherlands  

Professional Experience  
At SecureSphere, I architect security testing strategies for SaaS SOC2 products, ensuring compliance with ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks. My work directly influenced a 35% reduction in critical vulnerabilities in production systems over 18 months. Previously, as Test Lead at Sentinel Secure, I scaled chaos engineering for cloud-based threat detection platforms, introducing 12+ synthetic attack scenarios that increased system resilience by 28% during quarterly stress tests. At NetGuard Inc., I led API security testing for 15+ enterprise clients, designing automated test suites that cut regression time by 40% and reduced bug escapes by 30%. Early in my career at CyberShield Labs, a startup, I automated regression suites for intrusion detection systems, achieving 98% test coverage within 12 months of product launch.  

Projects  
Architected a REST API testing framework using Python and JMeter for NetGuard Inc., integrating with CI/CD pipelines to enable real-time security validation. This framework identified 140+ security gaps in customer-facing APIs, preventing potential $2M+ in breach costs. Developed a Go-based performance testing tool for Sentinel Secure’s cloud threat detection platform, simulating 10,000+ concurrent attacks to optimize resource allocation and reduce latency by 22%. Designed a CI/CD pipeline for SecureSphere’s SOC2 products, embedding automated security scans that cut manual testing hours by 60% and accelerated release cycles by 15%.  

Education  
Master of Science in Cybersecurity, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), 2012. Thesis: "Automated Vulnerability Detection in Distributed Systems: A Machine Learning Approach."

REST API design: Engineered scalable API testing frameworks for NetGuard Inc. and Sentinel Secure, integrating with CI/CD pipelines to enforce security validation at every deployment.  
CI/CD pipelines: Owned the development of SecureSphere’s CI/CD pipeline, embedding automated security scans and reducing manual testing hours by 60%.  
Go: Built high-performance testing tools for cloud threat detection platforms, achieving 22% latency reduction through optimized concurrency models.  
Performance testing (JMeter/k6): Conducted load testing for Sentinel Secure’s platform, simulating 10,000+ concurrent attacks to optimize resource allocation.  
Python: Developed automation scripts for API security testing, identifying 140+ vulnerabilities in customer-facing systems.  
API testing: Central to my identity; designed frameworks that cut regression time by 40% and reduced bug escapes by 30%.  
Security testing: Spearheaded security testing strategies for SaaS SOC2 products, ensuring compliance with ISO 27001 and NIST standards.  
Test automation: Pioneered test automation for intrusion detection systems, achieving 98% coverage within 12 months of product launch.
